title: 階梯式溢洪道~Stepped spillways
focus: 以階梯流態含氣與剩餘能量驗證陡槽性能~Verifying stepped-chute regimes aeration and residual energy
summary: 本課以以階梯流態含氣與剩餘能量驗證陡槽性能為主線，先用臨界水深與單寬流量與階高與相對尺度界定水力與構造條件，再將自含氣起點判讀、近壁低壓與氣蝕連結到縮尺黏性與可比性。以矩形斷面及均勻混合近似作示意，流態分界與氣蝕風險須依專案試驗。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。~This course develops verifying stepped-chute regimes aeration and residual energy through Critical depth and unit discharge and Step height and relative scale, then connects Self-aeration inception identification and Near-wall pressure and cavitation to Scale viscosity and comparability. Rectangular sections and uniform-mixture approximations illustrate behavior; regime boundaries and cavitation require project testing. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
history: 本課所研究的以階梯流態含氣與剩餘能量驗證陡槽性能，反映水工設計由單一尺寸選取走向水流、材料、施工與長期監測共同驗證的發展。以矩形斷面及均勻混合近似作示意，流態分界與氣蝕風險須依專案試驗。 美國墾務局官方目錄列有1978年消能工專論、1980年水力試驗技術及1987年小壩設計，這些是技術文件出版年份，不是本課假想工程的啟用日期。所列具名工程只供公開原理與邊界比較，不主張取得其設計圖、現場紀錄或專有參數。~The focus on verifying stepped-chute regimes aeration and residual energy reflects development from isolated sizing toward joint verification of flow, materials, construction and long-term observations. Rectangular sections and uniform-mixture approximations illustrate behavior; regime boundaries and cavitation require project testing. The Reclamation catalog lists the 1978 energy-dissipator monograph, 1980 hydraulic laboratory techniques and 1987 small-dam manual. These are publication dates, not commissioning dates for a hypothetical project. Named works support comparisons of public principles and boundaries; this course claims no access to proprietary drawings, field records or project parameters.
example: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查臨界水深與單寬流量：q=4 m2/s; g=9.81 m/s2; criticalDepth=(4**2/9.81)**(1/3)=1.17711 m；再獨立檢查階高與相對尺度：criticalDepth=1.2 m; stepHeight=0.6 m; relativeDepth=1.2/0.6=2 dimensionless。敏感度：單寬流量由4增至6m2/s時，臨界水深由1.177增為1.542m，增加31.0%；若階高不變，水深階高比隨之提高，但不能用此一比值作通用流態界線。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。以矩形斷面及均勻混合近似作示意，流態分界與氣蝕風險須依專案試驗。 將比較槽末清水等效比能與消能池入流工況表作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。~Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Critical depth and unit discharge: q=4 m2/s; g=9.81 m/s2; criticalDepth=(4**2/9.81)**(1/3)=1.17711 m. Independently examine Step height and relative scale: criticalDepth=1.2 m; stepHeight=0.6 m; relativeDepth=1.2/0.6=2 dimensionless. Sensitivity: raising unit discharge from4 to6m2/s increases critical depth from1.177 to1.542m, about31.0 percent. At fixed step height the relative depth rises, but this ratio alone is not a universal regime boundary. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Rectangular sections and uniform-mixture approximations illustrate behavior; regime boundaries and cavitation require project testing. Use the following independent check: Compare terminal clear-water equivalent energy with basin approach-condition tables. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.

units.anchor: 臨界水深與單寬流量~Critical depth and unit discharge
units.title: 臨界水深與單寬流量~Critical depth and unit discharge
units.mechanism: 階梯流態與流量相對階高有關，先以單寬流量求矩形明渠的臨界水深可建立尺度。此水深不是階面實際平均水深，也不是含氣混合水深；橫向不均流與入口曲率會改變局部條件，需另外量測入口過渡區。 驗證時應以全寬流量積分核對單寬值並標記階高與入口幾何，並辨識以下失效情境：把含氣厚度當臨界水深會混淆流態尺度。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Critical depth based on unit discharge supplies a reference scale for stepped-flow behavior. It is neither the actual mean depth above a step nor the aerated mixture depth. Transverse nonuniformity and entrance curvature alter local conditions and require measurements through the crest transition. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check unit discharge by full-width integration and record step height and entrance geometry. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Using aerated thickness as critical depth confuses the regime scale. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：q=4 m2/s; g=9.81 m/s2; criticalDepth=(4**2/9.81)**(1/3)=1.17711 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: q=4 m2/s; g=9.81 m/s2; criticalDepth=(4**2/9.81)**(1/3)=1.17711 m. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.
units.verify: 以全寬流量積分核對單寬值並標記階高與入口幾何。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「把含氣厚度當臨界水深會混淆流態尺度」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。~Check unit discharge by full-width integration and record step height and entrance geometry. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Using aerated thickness as critical depth confuses the regime scale. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.
units.failure: 把含氣厚度當臨界水深會混淆流態尺度。診斷時應採取以下查核：以全寬流量積分核對單寬值並標記階高與入口幾何，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。~Using aerated thickness as critical depth confuses the regime scale. Diagnose it by the following check: Check unit discharge by full-width integration and record step height and entrance geometry. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.
units.misconception: 臨界水深就是每一階上的實際水深~Critical depth equals actual flow depth on every step
units.practice: 交接時以以全寬流量積分核對單寬值並標記階高與入口幾何作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對把含氣厚度當臨界水深會混淆流態尺度，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。~At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Check unit discharge by full-width integration and record step height and entrance geometry. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Using aerated thickness as critical depth confuses the regime scale. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

units.anchor: 階高與相對尺度~Step height and relative scale
units.title: 階高與相對尺度~Step height and relative scale
units.mechanism: 階高改變水流是否逐階跌落或掠過階尖，水深階高比可整理試驗但還需陡槽坡度與入口邊界。過渡流態可能出現不規則噴濺與波動；不能把某一試驗的分界數值直接當成所有坡度皆適用的設計限制。 驗證時應在連續變流量試驗中記錄水舌是否撞擊階面及流態轉換，並辨識以下失效情境：只測單一流量會漏掉過渡流態的不規則噴濺。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Step height influences whether water cascades between steps or skims over their tips. A relative-depth ratio organizes experiments but slope and entrance conditions also matter. Transitional flow may splash irregularly; a boundary observed in one experiment is not a universal design limit across slopes. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Record nappe impact and regime transitions during a continuous discharge sweep. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Testing one discharge can miss irregular splashing in transitional flow. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：criticalDepth=1.2 m; stepHeight=0.6 m; relativeDepth=1.2/0.6=2 dimensionless。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: criticalDepth=1.2 m; stepHeight=0.6 m; relativeDepth=1.2/0.6=2 dimensionless. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

units.anchor: 階梯坡度與建造~Step geometry and construction
units.title: 階梯坡度與建造~Step geometry and construction
units.mechanism: 階梯由水平踏面與垂直階面組成，整體坡角影響重力沿坡分量、回流穴與施工模板。幾何閉合需核對總落差與總水平長度；局部突出或階尖錯台可能破壞原本流場，不能只驗收平均坡度而忽略局部平整性。 驗證時應逐階測量高程與踏面長度並與整體坡線閉合，並辨識以下失效情境：局部突出階尖可能增加低壓與磨耗集中。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Horizontal treads and vertical risers define the overall slope, influencing gravity components and recirculation cavities. Check total rise and horizontal run together. Local protrusions or displaced edges disturb the intended flow field, so average slope acceptance does not replace local surface and alignment surveys. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Survey every riser and tread and close them against the overall slope line. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A projecting step edge can concentrate low pressure and abrasion. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：stepRise=0.5 m; stepRun=1.0 m; slopeAngle=atan(0.5/1.0)=26.5651 degrees。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: stepRise=0.5 m; stepRun=1.0 m; slopeAngle=atan(0.5/1.0)=26.5651 degrees. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

units.anchor: 階穴剪切與耗能~Cavity shear and dissipation
units.title: 階穴剪切與耗能~Cavity shear and dissipation
units.mechanism: 掠流在階尖連線上形成高速主流，階穴內回流透過剪切交換動量與能量。給定平均剪應力乘界面面積及相對速度可估交換功率，但不是完整耗能模型；相對速度與應力需由試驗取得，不能憑階數直接累加能量損失。 驗證時應比較階穴速度場與界面剪應力並檢查沿程剩餘比能，並辨識以下失效情境：把每階耗能當固定常數會忽略沿程流態演變。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Skimming flow passes over step tips while cavity recirculation exchanges momentum through shear. Prescribed mean shear stress, interface area and relative velocity estimate transfer power, not a complete dissipation law. Obtain those quantities experimentally rather than assigning an identical energy loss to every step. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare cavity velocities and interface shear with residual specific energy downstream. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Assigning constant dissipation to every step ignores evolving flow conditions. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：meanShear=400 Pa; interfaceArea=3 m2; relativeVelocity=5 m/s; transferPower=400*3*5/1000=6 kW。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: meanShear=400 Pa; interfaceArea=3 m2; relativeVelocity=5 m/s; transferPower=400*3*5/1000=6 kW. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

units.anchor: 自含氣起點判讀~Self-aeration inception identification
units.title: 自含氣起點判讀~Self-aeration inception identification
units.mechanism: 湍流邊界層向自由水面發展後可開始大量捲氣，起點之前的近壁清水區可能更易受氣蝕影響。以觀測座標描述起點位置並不預測其隨流量變化；應結合壓力、含氣與邊界層量測，不能只看表面是否呈白色。 驗證時應沿槽測量近壁含氣率並將其與表面白化起點比較，並辨識以下失效情境：表面含氣但近壁仍清水可能留下局部氣蝕風險。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Air entrainment develops when turbulence reaches the free surface, leaving an upstream clear-water region potentially more vulnerable to cavitation. An observed inception coordinate does not predict its discharge dependence. Combine pressure, concentration and boundary-layer measurements rather than relying on a white surface appearance alone. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure near-wall air concentration along the chute and compare surface whitening onset. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: An aerated surface with clear water near the wall leaves local cavitation risk. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Measured inceptionDistance=18 m; totalChuteLength=60 m; clearRegionFraction=18/60=0.30 dimensionless。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: Measured inceptionDistance=18 m; totalChuteLength=60 m; clearRegionFraction=18/60=0.30 dimensionless. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: An aerated surface with clear water near the wall leaves local cavitation risk. units.anchor: 混合水深與牆高~Mixture depth and wall height
units.title: 混合水深與牆高~Mixture depth and wall height

A uniform-concentration relation estimates a sectional mean, while waves, splash and transverse convergence need additional checks. Wall height also involves structural and drainage requirements beyond one air-fraction calculation. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Integrate air profiles to check equivalent water depth and record wave crests. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Sizing walls to mean mixture depth alone overlooks wave overtopping. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 近壁低壓與氣蝕~Near-wall pressure and cavitation
units.title: 近壁低壓與氣蝕~Near-wall pressure and cavitation
units.mechanism: 階尖後方流動分離可產生低壓，局部壓力與蒸氣壓的距離比表面含氣外觀更直接。氣蝕指標需用一致的絕對壓力與參考速度；同一指標下表面缺陷與氣核不同仍會改變起始，因此需對實際階面品質驗證。 驗證時應同步量測階尖後低壓與近壁含氣率並記錄表面缺陷，並辨識以下失效情境：把表壓直接代入會錯估距蒸氣壓的餘量。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Separation behind step edges creates low pressure. Compare local absolute pressure with vapor pressure using a consistent velocity reference. Surface defects and nuclei affect inception even at similar indices; visible aeration does not replace verification of wall conditions and actual near-wall protection. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure downstream-edge pressure and near-wall air together and document surface defects. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Inserting gauge pressure directly misstates the margin above vapor pressure. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 下游剩餘能量~Downstream residual energy
units.title: 下游剩餘能量~Downstream residual energy
units.mechanism: 階梯可在陡槽沿程耗能，但下游仍有速度水頭與水深所含比能，需要與尾水和消能池配合。以矩形清水等效斷面估比能時應明示速度分布修正假設；不應因階梯表面看似激烈翻滾就宣稱可以省去末端消能。 驗證時應比較槽末清水等效比能與消能池入流工況表，並辨識以下失效情境：忽略剩餘速度水頭會低估下游沖刷需求。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Steps dissipate energy along the chute, yet depth and velocity head remain at its end. Coordinate that residual energy with tailwater and terminal dissipation. A rectangular clear-water equivalent section assumes a velocity-distribution correction; vigorous visible turbulence does not prove that a terminal basin is unnecessary. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare terminal clear-water equivalent energy with basin approach-condition tables. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Ignoring residual velocity head understates downstream scour demand. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 接縫滲壓與穩定~Joint pressure and slab stability
units.title: 接縫滲壓與穩定~Joint pressure and slab stability
units.mechanism: 階梯混凝土接縫可能將表面動壓傳入底部，反覆升降的底板下壓力影響錨定與接觸。平均淨水頭只給靜態揚力量級，堵塞排水與脈動相關性需另考慮；驗證必須涵蓋接縫、底層與排水出口的連續水路。 驗證時應量測接縫兩側與底板下壓力並核對排水出口流量，並辨識以下失效情境：排水堵塞會讓接縫入水轉成持續底板揚壓。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Concrete joints can transmit surface pressure beneath stepped slabs and impose cyclic uplift. Mean differential head provides a static scale only; drain blockage and pressure correlation need separate treatment. Verification must trace the connected route through joints, the underlying layer and drainage outlets. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure pressures across joints and beneath slabs and check drainage outlet flow. units.anchor: 縮尺黏性與可比性~Scale viscosity and comparability
units.title: 縮尺黏性與可比性~Scale viscosity and comparability
units.mechanism: 同水質福祿模型的速度隨長度平方根縮小，使雷諾數比按長度比的二分之三次方改變。小模型可能改變階穴紊流與含氣，結果需附尺度限制；應分開驗證整體水面線與細部氣泡機制，不能用單一相似準則涵蓋所有現象。 驗證時應列出原型與模型雷諾數並比較兩種模型尺度的含氣結果，並辨識以下失效情境：模型黏性過強會改變階穴交換與表面擾動。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~In a same-fluid Froude model, velocity scales with square root of length, making the Reynolds-number ratio length to the three-halves power. Small models may change cavity turbulence and aeration. Report scale limits and distinguish whole-profile validation from detailed bubble mechanisms rather than assuming universal similarity. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: List prototype and model Reynolds numbers and compare aeration at two model scales. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Excessive model viscosity changes cavity exchange and surface disturbance. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

sources.title: 美國墾務局水工手冊與專論目錄
sources.scope: 官方目錄核實 1978 消能工專論、1980 水力試驗技術、1987 小壩設計及1990氣蝕專論；目錄日期不是工程啟用年。
sources.scopeEn: Official catalog verifies the 1978 dissipator monograph, 1980 laboratory techniques, 1987 small-dam manual and 1990 cavitation monograph; publication dates are not project commissioning dates.

sources.title: 階梯溢洪道水力設計指引
sources.titleEn: Guidelines for Hydraulic Design of Stepped Spillways
sources.scope: 已取回2015年原始指引，包含流態、階高、含氣、邊牆與氣蝕議題；本課數值並非其設計範例。
sources.scopeEn: Retrieved the 2015 original guide covering regimes, step geometry, aeration, walls and cavitation; lesson quantities are not its design examples.

sources.title: USACE 溢洪道水力設計手冊
sources.scope: 官方索引核實EM1110-2-1603與1990年日期；直接頁面取回受限，不聲稱全文閱讀。
sources.scopeEn: Official index verifies EM1110-2-1603 and its 1990 date; direct retrieval was restricted, and full-text review is not claimed.

sources.title: 美國墾務局水工研究報告目錄
sources.scope: 官方目錄核實1987年Upper Stillwater階梯溢洪道研究及1971年Yellowtail摻氣研究，僅作技術文件時間軸。
sources.scopeEn: Official catalog verifies the 1987 Upper Stillwater stepped-spillway and 1971 Yellowtail aeration studies; used as publication chronology only.
